input: Unequal performance across groups is a risk associated with A facial recognition system is designed to identify and verify individuals, granting or denying access to a venue based on pre-defined criteria. The system aims to provide a secure and efficient way to manage entry, using advanced algorithms to match facial features with stored data. It seeks to accurately distinguish between authorized and unauthorized individuals, ensuring a safe environment for all users.
